verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a framework published as a public GitHub repo. You scaffold it locally with `npx degit solidjs/templates`, build it with Vite and TypeScript, and run it in your own environment. It supports SSR, serverless and isomorphic rendering, so nothing depends on a vendor-hosted service. Missing for 10: no explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, no first-party deployment or self-hosting guide, and no independent corroboration of self-hosted production deployments.
